content.title: Here’s What Friday’s New Moon in Aries Means for Every Star Sign
content.text: The first new moon of spring rises on April 17 at 7:52 a.m. Eastern time amidst the Lyrid meteor shower. The fiery lunation resides in the passionate sign Aries, motivating us to set our goals and ensure they come to fruition for the next four weeks. The raw, unfiltered, and primal influence of Aries gives us the vigor we need to charge onward and embark on our personal journeys.New moons occur at the beginning of the monthly lunar cycle, allowing us to explore our aspirations and desires with a fresh perspective. This is the universe’s way of pushing us to transform, evolve, and thrive in our pursuits. As the sun and moon link up, the moon becomes invisible to the human eye, encouraging us to overcome our fears and lean into our dreams.This particular new moon is simultaneously ravenous and restorative. If we factor in the Aries stellium (a cluster of planets in the same sign) consisting of the effervescent Sun, tender Moon, communicative Mercury, action-oriented Mars, authoritative Saturn, and elusive Neptune, the atmosphere becomes combustible, intense, and courageous. However, the centaur Chiron and asteroid Eris (celestial bodies that are both in Aries) want us to heal with purpose.Letting go of old sentiments or negative thoughts isn’t going to be easy, but we’re going to put our best foot forward to transcend under the sway of the bold new moon. Dare to take a step towards bettering ourselves.Read your new moon in Aries horoscope below.AriesAlthough it is not in your nature to ever doubt yourself, there have been a few occurrences that have made you feel less than, because situations are not changing on your timeline. The truth is, you are on your way to a major glow-up. The applause and admiration are coming during the New Moon—just be patient, ram.TaurusYou’re in the midst of a soul-search to elevate your aura and vibe. Use the New Moon to reflect, recollect, and ruminate over how you can evolve into the person you yearn to be. As your captivating spirit blossoms into greatness, it will be easy to see how to turn past experiences into a tool for immense growth.GeminiRather than focusing on yourself, the new moon honors a moment of nurturing others. Through acts of kindness, generosity, and charity, you’re giving your all to aid the world or your local community. Small acts of humanitarianism can go a long way when your heart is devoted to paying it forward. Hopefully, your goodness inspires other people to do the same.CancerDeveloping and refining a business model comes naturally, as it gives you foresight into your future trajectory. Blending your intuition and skillset is vital to planning, especially when you’re at the top of your game and want to reinvigorate your professional standing with fresh energy. Your potential and drive are endless if you utilize the New Moon to your advantage.LeoAs one of the most creative signs of the zodiac, you do not like to be stuck in an artistic rut. The new moon in Aries offers you a chance to roar out your imagination, talents, and visions. The stars are aligning for you to embrace your unique and inventive ideas and go beyond them. Spread your wings and fly!VirgoIf you’ve been feeling as though others aren’t prioritizing you, the new moon guarantees that you will receive prominence and acclaim. They’ll keep you in the loop, and you’ll be empowered knowing you are never forgotten and always on their minds. As a result, your confidence will reach a high, allowing you to get your Virgo groove back in relationships.
